correctness.rationale: Exact recurrence yields four-step matrix [[5,12],[12,29]] and integer quartic F with all coefficients divisible by six. Its substitution finite differences gain powers of three under -M congruent I mod3, and gain 4-adic factors under M congruent I mod4. The operator hockey-stick identity proves the congruence for every length 4m; Pell start n=0 and associated Pell start n=1 give exact 3-adic sharpness, and companion-oddness gives exact 2-adic sharpness. Remaining residues are handled by explicit modulo-2 and modulo-3 period four, with all quantifiers and normalization specified. The exact self-contained code checks 600 length/sequence instances and 2100 block-congruence instances, but is not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: An exact local classification for two prime parts across all positive window lengths and both Pell companion sequences, in the first higher even exponent beyond the motivating square-power literature, is a nontrivial structural result: valuations can grow unboundedly, the 3-adic obstruction has a sharp four-divisibility threshold, and the 2-adic part distinguishes the companion sequences by one power. The block-lifting proof explains these phenomena rather than merely tabulating values. This is a motivated partial invariant, not a claimed full GCD or arbitrary slice.
